fullPassage: Imagine you take your bicycle to a repair shop. You expect the workers at the shop to do what you paid them to do, which is to fix your bicycle. If they do a good job, you will be back again next time for bike repairs. If they do a bad job, however, you will look for a new repair shop. The same is true with governments. It is our job as citizens to make sure that government does what is expected. If they do a good job, we can trust them in the future. If they don't, we can explain why we won't vote for them again. This kind of participation in government is important. How much effort we put into participating depends on how well we think the government is doing. If we are satisfied, we will do very little besides voting. But if we are dissatisfied, we will probably take other types of action.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: expect(기대하다) → expected(과거분사). be동사(is) 뒤 수동태 be + p.p.
det.analysis: expect를 expected로 변환. 'what is expected'(기대되는 것) — be동사 is 뒤에 수동태를 만드는 과거분사 expected가 필요
det.tip: is _____ → 수동태(be + p.p.) → expected

questions.passage: Imagine you take your bicycle to a repair shop. You expect the workers at the shop to do what you paid them to do, which is to fix your bicycle. If they do a good job, you will be back again next time for bike repairs. If they do a bad job, however, you will look for a new repair shop. The same is true with governments. It is our job as citizens to make sure that government does what is expected. If they do a good job, we can trust them in the future. If they don't, we can explain why we won't vote for them again. This kind of participation in government is important. How much effort we put into participating depends on how well we think the government is doing. If we are satisfied, we will do very little besides voting. But if we are dissatisfied, we will probably take other types of action.
questions.stem: 위 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 핵심: 정부도 수리점처럼 감시·평가해야 하며 시민 참여가 중요하다
det.analysis:
① 자전거 타기: 소재일 뿐 주제 아님
② 정비공 판별: 도입 비유일 뿐
③ 시민이 정부에 참여하고 감시해야 하는 이유 — 전체 흐름과 일치 ←정답
④ 투표 제도: 투표는 일부 예시일 뿐
det.tip: 수리점 비유 → 정부 감시·참여의 중요성

ch: 시민이 정부에 참여하고 감시해야 하는 이유

questions.stem: 위 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 요지: 참여의 정도는 정부 평가에 달려 있고, 불만족하면 행동한다
det.analysis:
① 의견 무시: 본문과 반대
② 자전거 신뢰: 도입 비유일 뿐
③ 투표 유일 권리: 투표 외 다른 행동도 언급

다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 따라 빈칸을 완성하시오. (영어로)
'당신이 그들에게 하라고 지불한 것'
[조건] (1) do, paid, them, to, what, you를 모두 사용
(2) 6단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: what you paid them to do = 당신이 그들에게 하라고 지불한 것
det.analysis: 관계대명사 what(선행사 포함) + 주어(you) + 동사(paid) + 목적어(them) + to부정사(to do). 원문: 'to do what you paid them to do'
